title: update

goal.text: Update claw-kit on the DSH host to the latest published CLI and adapter.

requirements.summary: Refresh the global claw CLI and the @veewo/dsh-claw-kit profile plugin as one update unit, then verify activation.
acceptanceCriteria: The installed claw CLI is the target version and accepts --host dsh.
The DSH profile bundles @veewo/dsh-claw-kit at the target version.
After the Host restart the claw_run tool and the bundled skills declared by the installed package are present.

tasks.title: Detect the current and target versions
tasks.detail: Resolve the current authorized profile; ask if unknown and never default to web. Run claw --version and read the installed adapter version (dsh --profile <name> --dump-config / profile package.json). Resolve the latest published @veewo/claw and @veewo/dsh-claw-kit versions from the npm registry.

tasks.title: Update the global claw CLI
tasks.detail: npm install -g @veewo/claw@latest; confirm claw --version matches the target. After restarting DSH, verify host-scoped recovery through claw_run(operation: context, args: {}).

tasks.title: Update the DSH adapter in the profile
tasks.detail: dsh plugin --profile <name> add @veewo/dsh-claw-kit@latest; confirm the profile bundles list carries @veewo/dsh-claw-kit and dsh --profile <name> --dump-config shows the claw-kit row.

tasks.title: Restart the Host and verify activation
tasks.detail: Restart the authorized DSH profile only with separate explicit restart authorization; otherwise report on-disk installation and wait for the owner's restart. Then verify claw_run and the bundled skills declared by the installed package (including feature-architecture and knowledge-capture) in a real session; use claw_run context as the non-mutating recovery smoke check.

rules: Never use unpublished workspace files as the update source.
CLI and adapter are one validation unit; do not report success until both are verified.
A new package version is not activation proof; require a real session with claw_run.
